iconicAnchor.label: Joseph Henry's Record of Experiments
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The Smithsonian describes dated, carefully maintained notebooks that record experimental progress, immediate scraps, measurements, reflection, revisions, and priority claims.

sources.title: Record of Experiments Introduction
supports: Laboratory notebooks can serve as dated working records that document experiments, evolving thought, later annotations, and the evidentiary sequence of research.

sources.title: Joseph Henry Notebook, Sound, Weather, 1865-1866
supports: A real pocket notebook combines subject notes, instruments, experimental materials, measurements, data, and diagrams across a working sequence.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set.
